config.notes: Wintec (NZ) course pages at www.wintec.ac.nz/study-at-wintec/courses/<area>/<slug>, server-rendered HTML, no page JSON. A 'Course details' panel near the top prints, in order: start months as 'Feb 2027 Jul 2027' (intakes), duration ('One year'), mode ('Full-time or Part-time'), a fee with '*' that is the DOMESTIC fee (e.g. $9,561* + Fees Free note), NZQF level ('Level 8'), 'Available for International Students', a link 'International Fee Guideline' (international fees are only in that separate guide, not on the page), then campus. No fee pattern: the page fee is domestic. No IELTS on course pages: central rule at https://www.wintec.ac.nz/international/international-academic-entry-requirements (L4 and below 5.5/5.0; L5-7 6.0/5.5; L8+ 6.5/6.0); Bachelor of Nursing and NZ Diploma in Enrolled Nursing 6.5 in all bands (nursing English PDF). Semesters per https://www.wintec.ac.nz/student-resources/student-events: Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July. Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22, for review): the "Entry criteria" text (general academic admission). Exit awards: only module-based exits (e.g. PG Dip Nursing to PG Cert after two modules), no full-time years, so none linked. No fee amount in the stored text ("International Fee Guideline" is a link), so no whole-course fee.
